reviews.comment:
Cuando van a poner dos playeros por isla en la horas con mayor demanda? Es inumano pasar 8 hrs sin descanso con los calores de verano. Los playeros unos genios armados de paciencia atienden a todos con la mejor. Aveces se tarda más en cobrar con el celular de lo que cargan combustible. Ojalá pueda mejorar este servicio por el bien de todo el pueblo.

(Translated by Google)
When are they going to put two attendants per island during peak hours? It's inhumane to spend eight hours without a break in the summer heat. The attendants are geniuses, armed with patience, and they serve everyone very well. Sometimes it takes longer to process the payment on their cell phones than it takes to fill up the tank. I hope this service can be improved for the good of the entire community.
